packageRules.description: Manage the Node engine floor by hand; rangeStrategy:pin must not pin it to a single patch release.
Track vite-plus minor and patch updates as separate PRs (beta 0.x).
Auto-merge individual non-major devDependency updates once CI is green.
Vite+ and its core package move in lockstep. The resulting PR is the manual anchor for aligning its embedded test and lint toolchain.
prBodyNotes: Before merging, verify the resolved Vite+ test/lint package family and any security overrides, regenerate the lockfile, and run the complete workspace checks.

packageRules.description: These direct pins must remain compatible with the versions embedded by Vite+ and with each other; standalone Renovate updates are not coherent.
Preserve the two sanctioned fast-check caret ranges and require manual review for changes outside them.
